_notes.dump: Mario Kart Wii Team Warfare PAL dump; game ID MTWP01; captured in a single-player race.
_notes.confidence: confirmed means pointer/structure was observed or field offset is explicitly documented; uncertain fields are marked individually.
_notes.raceData: dynamic base is the inline RacedataPlayer record for that player, not the Racedata singleton. CurrentLap discrepancy: mkw-structures labels RaceinfoPlayer::currentLap uint16 at +0x24, but supplied dump bytes +0x24/+0x25 are 01 00 for lap 1 while maxLap is at +0x26. UI uses first byte (+0x24) as a candidate uint8; CurrentLapDocumented16 retains the original uint16 read. Marked uncertain. CurrentLap discrepancy: mkw-structures labels RaceinfoPlayer::currentLap uint16 at +0x24, but supplied dump bytes +0x24/+0x25 are 01 00 for lap 1 while maxLap is at +0x26. CurrentLap preserves the documented uint16 read; CurrentLapCandidate reads the first byte (+0x24) as a candidate uint8 for the UI. Both are marked uncertain.
_notes.raceInfoPlayer: dynamic base is the RaceinfoPlayer object pointer for that player.
_notes.RaceState: the old 0x80ABCDEF value was a placeholder and has been removed; no real RaceState address was established.
_notes.PlayerSub14: pointer is cached, but the supplied structures repository documents no member layout for PlayerSub14.
_notes.legacyAliases: PlayersId is retained as an alias of CharacterId; VehiclesId is retained as an alias of VehicleId for the existing DebugManager.
_notes.PlayerTrick: PlayerTrick pointers are non-null for all 12 slots in the supplied dump; the documented object fields are included.
_notes.PlayerSub1c: PlayerSub1c includes a vtable at +0x00; bitfield0 begins at +0x04. The five bitfields were aligned to this observed layout.
_notes.TrickPlayerSub10Pointer: PlayerTrick::playerSub10 pointer is inconsistent in local slot 0 and should be verified.
_notes.PlayerHolder: PlayerHolder base is shared by all 12 slots; playerCount is 12 in the supplied dump.
_notes.rawBlocks: Raw byte-block resources are included for structures with unknown or partially documented members. PlayerSub10BikeExtensionRaw is bike-only and marked uncertain.
_notes.bikeExtension: The bike extension base is PlayerSub10 + 0x294. Its fields are only meaningful when PlayerParams.IsBike is nonzero.
_notes.GameManagerHeartbeat: Address retained from the pre-existing configuration, but its semantics are unverified.

items.itemHandler: ITEMHandler::sInstance pointer is documented at 0x809C20F8. ITEMPacket is 8 bytes; sendPackets[2] occupy 0x00-0x0F, recvPackets[12] occupy 0x10-0x6F, times[12] begin at 0xA0. Bytes in packets are deliberately exposed raw because ITEMPacket field definitions are not included in supplied structures.
items.itemBehaviourTable: itemBehaviourTable[19] begins at 0x809C36A0; each ItemBehaviour is 0x1C bytes. Known member offsets: objectId +0x04, numberOfItems +0x08, useType +0x14, useFunction +0x18.
items.itemSlotData: ItemSlotData::sInstance pointer location is 0x809C3670. Its instance members are documented, but live table pointer/array targets have not yet been validated against the supplied race dump. Instance size is 0x48. playerChances +0x10, cpuChances +0x18, specialChances +0x20, itemsInWheel pointer +0x28, specialBoxItemsInWheel pointer +0x2C, itemSpawnTimers[4] +0x34, playerCount +0x44.
